site.name: animdiagram
site.tagline: Looping animated SVG explainers. One file, one <style>, no script.

entries.title: News feed fan-out
entries.source: System Design Interview · news feed, fan-out on write
entries.claim: One post becomes N feed entries at write time, so every friend's read is a cache hit.
entries.cuts: web tier, load balancer, DNS, notification service, user cache and user DB — the read path is a second diagram.

entries.title: Rate limiter
entries.source: System Design Interview · rate limiter middleware
entries.claim: Over the limit, the middleware answers 429 itself; the API servers only ever see the allowed share.
entries.cuts: rules store and rule-refresh workers, drop-vs-queue option for refused requests.

entries.title: AI agents at scale
entries.source: Azure Architecture Center · AI agents at scale (AKS + Foundry)
entries.claim: The prompt crosses the gateway once; everything after it stays on private endpoints inside the VNet.
entries.cuts: load balancer, container registry, key vault, storage, Redis, Entra ID, Monitor / App Insights, private DNS, DDoS plan.

entries.title: Serverless web app
entries.source: AWS reference architecture · serverless web application
entries.claim: No server waits for the request; each hop exists, and is billed, only while it runs.
entries.cuts: Cognito user pool (folded into the gateway's authorizer sublabel), Amplify hosting, CloudWatch, DynamoDB streams.

entries.title: Streaming on GCP
entries.source: Google Cloud Architecture Center · streaming analytics
entries.claim: The producer is acknowledged immediately; the warehouse write happens later, off the device's clock.
primitives: immediate ack on the same stroke
entries.cuts: Looker / BI layer, Bigtable serving path, Dataflow autoscaling, dead-letter topic, IoT Core ingestion.

entries.title: Consistent hashing
entries.source: System Design Interview · consistent hashing, adding a server
entries.claim: Adding a server moves only the keys between it and its predecessor; every other key stays put.
entries.cuts: virtual nodes, server removal, replication to the next N servers, the ring drawn as a circle (orthogonal space instead).

entries.title: Long polling
entries.source: System Design Interview · chat system, long polling
entries.claim: Ask once and let the server hold the request until something happens; idle round trips disappear.
entries.cuts: WebSocket alternative, timeout-and-retry on the held request, message persistence, presence.

entries.title: RAG on GKE
entries.source: Google Cloud Architecture Center · RAG-capable generative AI app using GKE
entries.claim: Retrieval runs before generation; the model only ever sees a prompt already stuffed with the nearest chunks.
entries.cuts: Responsible AI service, logging / monitoring / analytics, chat interface as a separate box, Ray Data sharding step, Cloud Storage FUSE driver, external vs internal sources.
